title: The Independent Sound presents a new track "Undeniable"
htmlContent:
The Independent Sound's "Undeniable" is a record that is truly undeniable. In a craft like music it can all hang on the listener on what’s considered good, but the level he brings on this record surpasses that subjectivity with golden touch to every facet of the record, that makes it stand out and shine to keep us coming back for more.
